audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed every linked APD6 row against primary PDF/XML text, Fig. 1A sequence image, OA package members, and merged APD6 CSV rows. Database-only wording was not promoted to primary evidence.

record_audits.database_subject: Hill_BB_C10074 APD6 entry-level activity and sequence summary
record_audits.database_measure: APD6 summarizes anti-Gram-negative activity, 250 ug/mL / 17 uM PaO1 inhibition, His-tag recombinant production, and APD sequence analysis.

source_locator.locator: figure:Fig. 1A amino-acid sequence; signal peptide underlined
source_locator.primary_source_statement: Fig. 1A visually supports the APD6 mature sequence after the signal peptide, while the article text gives inconsistent precursor/mature length counts.

sequence_check.modification_note: Primary paper studies an N-terminal 6xHis-tagged recombinant mature protein; the APD6 sequence is the mature Hill_BB_C10074 sequence, not the expression construct with tags.

activity_check.conflict_reason: APD6 says PaO1 was inhibited at 17 uM (250 ug/mL) but not other bacteria tested. The primary paper supports 250 ug/mL PaO1 inhibition and no S. aureus inhibition, but it also reports a small significant E. coli K12 inhibition and does not print 17 uM as a primary source unit.

record_audits.conflict_context: source_conflict: APD6 identity is linked to the paper, but activity wording and length/unit details require caution; primary-source-supported activity rows preserve the paper values instead of copying the APD6 summary verbatim.
record_audits.review_notes: Preserve APD6 as source_conflict rather than database_only_no_primary_source: the paper verifies the entity and activity direction but not every database summary detail.
